scenes.text: Unlike fractions have different denominator-sized parts. Find a common denominator before combining them.
Work out 3/4 minus 1/2. The answer is 1/4. Use a common denominator, combine numerators and simplify to 1/4.
Two measured lengths in the class garden are 1/2 m and 1/4 m. Find their total. Pause to choose and explain.
Two measured lengths in the class garden are 1/2 m and 1/4 m. Find their total. The answer is 3/4. Use a common denominator, combine numerators and simplify to 3/4.
